newsitem.title: USA: STI Inc names chief executive officer.
newsitem.headline: STI Inc names chief executive officer.

text.p: STI Inc said Monday that Marcel Kole joined the company as chief executive officer and also will assume the responsibilities of chief financial officer.
George Stodola, former chief executive officer of the firm, remains chief executive of STI Plastics Inc, a newly created, wholly owned operating company.
Most recently, Kole had been chief operating officer and chief financial officer at United Recycling.

"The ultimate goal of STI Inc is to significantly increase shareholder value," Kole said in a statement. "We are currently looking at a number of acquisition/merger opportunities that will go a long way toward meeting this objective."
STI is a custom injection molder of plastics.
